crossRefs.note: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not…
All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”
Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body…
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

translations.web: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
translations.bsb: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.
translations.kjv: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
translations.asv: And they went to bury her; but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
